verdicts.reason: A keeps the sun logo and SOLSTICE wordmark readable and stacks the headline cleanly, but the orange CTA is blown up almost to headline size, which flattens the original's quiet hierarchy, and it sits a little close to the bottom edge. B shrinks the logo until the wordmark can't be read, breaks the CTA over three lines with an orphaned "Line", and jams the CTA against the headline with almost no gap, so the bottom of the layout feels crowded and top-heavy.
